```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

bouts0305 = read_csv("Bouts_0305.csv")

convert_mmss <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%02d:%04.1f", floor(x / 60), x %% 60)
}

# -----------------------------
# 18_17_10
# -----------------------------

bouts_18_17_10 = bouts0305 |>
  filter(Video == "0428_18_17_10")

clean_18_17_10 <- bouts_18_17_10 %>%
  filter(Event %in% c("Exp_social","Exp_freeze","Exp_approach","Int_approach")) %>%
  arrange(Start_frame) %>%
  mutate(
    Event = recode(Event,
      Exp_social = "social",
      Exp_freeze = "freeze",
      Exp_approach = "approach",
      Int_approach = "Non-approach"
    ),
    start = convert_mmss(Start_frame / 30),
    end   = convert_mmss(End_frame / 30)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Event) %>%
  mutate(bout = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Event, bout, start, end) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Event,
    values_from = c(start, end),
    names_glue = "{Event}_{.value}"
  ) |>
  select(bout,
    social_start, social_end,
    freeze_start, freeze_end,
    approach_start, approach_end,
    `Non-approach_start`, `Non-approach_end`
  )
```

```{r}
time_to_min <- function(x) {
  x_na <- is.na(x)
  parts <- strsplit(x[!x_na], ":")
  mins <- sapply(parts, function(p) as.numeric(p[1]) + as.numeric(p[2])/60)
  out <- numeric(length(x))
  out[x_na] <- NA
  out[!x_na] <- mins
  return(out)
}

# -----------------------------
# General function to process bouts
# -----------------------------
process_bouts <- function(df, type = c("simba","manual")) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  
  if(type == "simba") {
    df_processed <- df %>%
      rename(end_time = `End Time`) %>%
      mutate(
        start_min = Start_time / 60,
        end_min = end_time / 60,
        Behavior = case_when(
          Event == "Exp_approach" ~ "approach",
          Event == "Exp_freeze"   ~ "freeze",
          Event == "Exp_social"   ~ "social",
          TRUE ~ "non-approach"
        ),
        source = "SimBA"
      ) %>%
      select(source, Behavior, start_min, end_min)
    
  } else if(type == "manual") {
    df_processed <- df %>%
      rename(
        social_start = `social start`,
        social_end   = `social end`,
        freeze_start = `freeze start`,
        freeze_end   = `freeze end`
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        across(ends_with(c("start","end")), time_to_min)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(social_start, social_end, freeze_start, freeze_end),
        names_to = c("Behavior","type"),
        names_sep = "_"
      ) %>%
      group_by(Behavior) %>%
      mutate(bout_id = ceiling(row_number()/2)) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = type,
        values_from = value
      ) %>%
      rename(
        start_min = start,
        end_min   = end
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(source = "Manual") %>%
      select(source, Behavior, start_min, end_min, bout_id)
  }
  
  return(df_processed)
}

# -----------------------------
# Function to combine and plot
# -----------------------------
plot_bouts_wide <- function(simba_df, manual_df, xlim = c(0,7)) {
  
  # Combine
  plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_df, manual_df) %>%
    mutate(
      # assign numeric y positions
      y_bottom = ifelse(source == "SimBA", 0.9, 1.02),
      y_top    = ifelse(source == "SimBA", 1.0, 1.12)
    )
  
  ggplot(plot_df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = start_min, xmax = end_min,
                  ymin = y_bottom, ymax = y_top,
                  fill = Behavior),
              color = NA) +  # rectangles touching
    scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim, name = "Time (minutes)") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(0.95, 1.1),
      labels = c("SimBA", "Manual"),
      limits = c(0.85, 1.2)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "approach" = "#E69F00",       # bright orange
        "freeze"   = "#0072B2",       # dark blue for high contrast
        "social"   = "#66CC00",       # bright green/lime
        "non-approach" = "#999999"    # gray
      )
    ) +
    labs(y = NULL, fill = "Behavior") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
}

# -----------------------------
# Example usage
# -----------------------------
simba_df   <- process_bouts(bouts_18_17_10, type = "simba")
manual_df  <- process_bouts(Sophie_18_17_10, type = "manual")
plot_bouts_wide(simba_df, manual_df)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Convert times to minutes safely
# -----------------------------
time_to_min <- function(x) {
  x_na <- is.na(x)
  parts <- strsplit(x[!x_na], ":")
  mins <- sapply(parts, function(p) as.numeric(p[1]) + as.numeric(p[2])/60)
  out <- numeric(length(x))
  out[x_na] <- NA
  out[!x_na] <- mins
  return(out)
}

# -----------------------------
# Manual pipeline for Sophie datasets
# Handles cases with or without freeze columns
# -----------------------------
manual_pipeline <- function(df) {
  
  # Check which columns exist
  has_freeze <- all(c("freeze start","freeze end") %in% names(df))
  
  if(!has_freeze) {
    # If no freeze, just handle social
    df_processed <- df %>%
      mutate(
        start_min = time_to_min(`social start`),
        end_min   = time_to_min(`social end`),
        Behavior  = "social",
        source    = "Manual",
        bout_id   = row_number()
      ) %>%
      select(source, Behavior, start_min, end_min, bout_id)
    
  } else {
    # If freeze columns exist, handle both
    df_processed <- df %>%
      mutate(
        social_start  = time_to_min(`social start`),
        social_end    = time_to_min(`social end`),
        freeze_start  = time_to_min(`freeze start`),
        freeze_end    = time_to_min(`freeze end`)
      ) %>%
      # Gather into long format safely
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = c(social_start, social_end, freeze_start, freeze_end),
        names_to = c("Behavior","type"),
        names_sep = "_",
        values_drop_na = TRUE
      ) %>%
      group_by(Behavior) %>%
      mutate(bout_id = ceiling(row_number()/2)) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = type,
        values_from = value
      ) %>%
      rename(
        start_min = start,
        end_min   = end
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(source = "Manual") %>%
      select(source, Behavior, start_min, end_min, bout_id)
  }
  
  return(df_processed)
}

# -----------------------------
# Example usage
# -----------------------------
manual_df <- manual_pipeline(Sophie_20_23_51)   # works even if no freeze columns
simba_df  <- process_bouts(bouts_20_23_51, type = "simba")
plot_bouts_wide(simba_df, manual_df)
```

```{r}
manual_df <- manual_pipeline(Sophie_21_33_38)   # works even if no freeze columns
simba_df  <- process_bouts(bouts_21_33_38, type = "simba")
plot_bouts_wide(simba_df, manual_df)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------
# Convert "MM:SS" to minutes
# -----------------------------
time_to_min <- function(x) {
  x_na <- is.na(x)
  parts <- strsplit(x[!x_na], ":")
  mins <- sapply(parts, function(p) as.numeric(p[1]) + as.numeric(p[2])/60)
  out <- numeric(length(x))
  out[x_na] <- NA
  out[!x_na] <- mins
  return(out)
}

# -----------------------------
# Tidy Sophie
# -----------------------------
Sophie_tidy <- Sophie_18_17_10 %>%
  mutate(
    social_start = time_to_min(`social start`),
    social_end   = time_to_min(`social end`),
    freeze_start = time_to_min(`freeze start`),
    freeze_end   = time_to_min(`freeze end`)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(social_start, social_end, freeze_start, freeze_end),
    names_to = c("Behavior","type"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Behavior) %>%
  mutate(bout_id = ceiling(row_number()/2)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = (end - start) * 60,   # seconds
    bout_class = ifelse(bout_time <= 2, "<=2s", ">2s")
  ) %>%
  select(Behavior, start, end, bout_time, bout_class, bout_id)

# -----------------------------
# Tidy Clean
# -----------------------------
clean_tidy <- clean_18_17_10 %>%
  mutate(
    social_start = time_to_min(social_start),
    social_end   = time_to_min(social_end),
    freeze_start = time_to_min(freeze_start),
    freeze_end   = time_to_min(freeze_end)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(social_start, social_end, freeze_start, freeze_end),
    names_to = c("Behavior","type"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Behavior) %>%
  mutate(bout_id = ceiling(row_number()/2)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Behavior, start, end, bout_id)
clean_tidy <- clean_tidy %>%
  mutate(
    bout_time = (end - start) * 60,            # seconds
    bout_class = ifelse(bout_time <= 2, "<=2s", ">2s")
  )
# -----------------------------
# Compute proportion of total overlapping time
# -----------------------------
compute_total_overlap <- function(sophie, clean, behavior) {
  sophie_behavior <- sophie %>% filter(Behavior == behavior)
  clean_behavior  <- clean %>% filter(Behavior == behavior)
  
  # overlapping time per bout
  overlap_time <- mapply(function(s_start, s_end) {
    overlaps <- pmax(0, pmin(s_end, clean_behavior$end) - pmax(s_start, clean_behavior$start))
    sum(overlaps, na.rm = TRUE) * 60
  }, sophie_behavior$start, sophie_behavior$end)
  
  # total proportion
  total_overlap <- sum(overlap_time) / sum(sophie_behavior$bout_time)
  
  # proportion by bout_class
  by_class <- sophie_behavior %>%
    mutate(overlap_time = overlap_time) %>%
    group_by(bout_class) %>%
    summarise(
      perc_overlap = sum(overlap_time) / sum(bout_time),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  list(total = total_overlap, by_class = by_class)
}

# -----------------------------
# Compute for social and freeze
# -----------------------------
social_overlap <- compute_total_overlap(Sophie_tidy, clean_tidy, "social")
freeze_overlap <- compute_total_overlap(Sophie_tidy, clean_tidy, "freeze")

social_overlap2 <- compute_total_overlap(clean_tidy, Sophie_tidy, "social")
freeze_overlap2 <- compute_total_overlap(clean_tidy, Sophie_tidy, "freeze")

# -----------------------------
# Results
# -----------------------------
social_overlap$total       # total % of social time overlapping
social_overlap$by_class    # % overlapping by bout_class

freeze_overlap$total       # total % of freeze time overlapping
freeze_overlap$by_class    # % overlapping by bout_class

social_overlap2$total       # total % of social time overlapping
social_overlap2$by_class    # % overlapping by bout_class

freeze_overlap2$total       # total % of freeze time overlapping
freeze_overlap2$by_class    # % overlapping by bout_class
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------
# Convert "MM:SS" to minutes
# -----------------------------
time_to_min <- function(x) {
  x_na <- is.na(x)
  parts <- strsplit(x[!x_na], ":")
  mins <- sapply(parts, function(p) as.numeric(p[1]) + as.numeric(p[2])/60)
  out <- numeric(length(x))
  out[x_na] <- NA
  out[!x_na] <- mins
  return(out)
}

# -----------------------------
# Function to tidy a dataframe
# -----------------------------
tidy_Sophie <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      social_start = time_to_min(`social start`),
      social_end   = time_to_min(`social end`),
      freeze_start = time_to_min(`freeze start`),
      freeze_end   = time_to_min(`freeze end`)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(social_start, social_end, freeze_start, freeze_end),
      names_to = c("Behavior","type"),
      names_sep = "_"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Behavior) %>%
    mutate(bout_id = ceiling(row_number()/2)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = type,
      values_from = value,
      values_fn = list(start = min, end = max) # collapse duplicates safely
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      start = as.numeric(start),
      end   = as.numeric(end),
      bout_time  = (end - start) * 60,
      bout_class = ifelse(bout_time <= 2, "<=2s", ">2s")
    ) %>%
    select(Behavior, start, end, bout_time, bout_class, bout_id)
}

tidy_clean <- function(df, max_time = NULL) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      social_start = time_to_min(social_start),
      social_end   = time_to_min(social_end),
      freeze_start = time_to_min(freeze_start),
      freeze_end   = time_to_min(freeze_end)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(social_start, social_end, freeze_start, freeze_end),
      names_to = c("Behavior","type"),
      names_sep = "_"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Behavior) %>%
    mutate(bout_id = ceiling(row_number()/2)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Optional: remove any bouts that start after max_time
    { if (!is.null(max_time)) filter(., start <= max_time) else . } %>%
    mutate(
      bout_time = (end - start) * 60,
      bout_class = ifelse(bout_time <= 2, "<=2s", ">2s")
    ) %>%
    select(Behavior, start, end, bout_time, bout_class, bout_id)
}

# -----------------------------
# Function to filter clean bouts before last Sophie end
# -----------------------------
filter_clean_by_sophie <- function(clean_df, sophie_df) {
  max_sophie_end <- max(sophie_df$end, na.rm = TRUE)
  clean_df %>% filter(end <= max_sophie_end)
}

# -----------------------------
# Function to compute total overlaps
# -----------------------------
compute_total_overlap <- function(sophie, clean, behavior) {
  sophie_behavior <- sophie %>% filter(Behavior == behavior)
  clean_behavior  <- clean %>% filter(Behavior == behavior)
  
  overlap_time <- mapply(function(s_start, s_end) {
    overlaps <- pmax(0, pmin(s_end, clean_behavior$end) - pmax(s_start, clean_behavior$start))
    sum(overlaps, na.rm = TRUE) * 60
  }, sophie_behavior$start, sophie_behavior$end)
  
  total_overlap <- sum(overlap_time) / sum(sophie_behavior$bout_time)
  
  by_class <- sophie_behavior %>%
    mutate(overlap_time = overlap_time) %>%
    group_by(bout_class) %>%
    summarise(perc_overlap = sum(overlap_time) / sum(bout_time),
              .groups = "drop")
  
  list(total = total_overlap, by_class = by_class)
}

# -----------------------------
# Example usage for Sophie / Clean
# -----------------------------
Sophie_tidy <- tidy_Sophie(Sophie_18_17_10)
clean_tidy  <- tidy_clean(clean_18_17_10) %>%
  filter_clean_by_sophie(Sophie_tidy)

# Compute overlaps
social_overlap  <- compute_total_overlap(Sophie_tidy, clean_tidy, "social")
freeze_overlap  <- compute_total_overlap(Sophie_tidy, clean_tidy, "freeze")
social_overlap2 <- compute_total_overlap(clean_tidy, Sophie_tidy, "social")
freeze_overlap2 <- compute_total_overlap(clean_tidy, Sophie_tidy, "freeze")

# Results
social_overlap$total
social_overlap$by_class

freeze_overlap$total
freeze_overlap$by_class

social_overlap2$total
social_overlap2$by_class

freeze_overlap2$total
freeze_overlap2$by_class
```

```{r}
tidy_Sophie_no_freeze <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      social_start = time_to_min(`social start`),
      social_end   = time_to_min(`social end`)
      # freeze columns ignored
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(social_start, social_end),
      names_to = c("Behavior","type"),
      names_sep = "_"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Behavior) %>%
    mutate(bout_id = ceiling(row_number()/2)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = type,
      values_from = value,
      values_fn = list(start = min, end = max)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      start = as.numeric(start),
      end   = as.numeric(end),
      bout_time  = (end - start) * 60,
      bout_class = ifelse(bout_time <= 2, "<=2s", ">2s")
    ) %>%
    select(Behavior, start, end, bout_time, bout_class, bout_id)
}
```

```{r}
bouts_0326 = read_csv("Bouts_0326.csv")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

merge_bouts <- function(df, gap = 1) {
  
  df %>%
    arrange(Video, Event, Start_time) %>%
    group_by(Video, Event) %>%
    
    # Compute gap from previous bout
    mutate(
      gap_prev = Start_time - lag(`End Time`)
    ) %>%
    
    # Start a new group if gap > threshold or first row
    mutate(
      new_group = ifelse(is.na(gap_prev) | gap_prev > gap, 1, 0),
      group_id = cumsum(new_group)
    ) %>%
    
    # Merge within each group
    group_by(Video, Event, group_id) %>%
    summarise(
      Start_time = first(Start_time),
      `End Time` = last(`End Time`),
      Start_frame = first(Start_frame),
      End_frame = last(End_frame),
      Bout_time = `End Time` - Start_time,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    
    arrange(Video, Event, Start_time)
}
bouts_0326 <- merge_bouts(bouts_0326, gap = 1)
bouts_0326 = bouts_0326 |>
  filter(Bout_time >= 0.5) |>
  filter(Bout_time <= 1)
convert_mmss2 <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%02d:%05.2f", floor(x / 60), x %% 60)
}

process_video <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  out <- df %>%
    filter(Video == video_name,
           Event %in% c("Passive", "Social", "Freeze")) %>%
    arrange(Start_time) %>%
    mutate(
      Event = tolower(Event),
      start = convert_mmss2(Start_time),
      end   = convert_mmss2(`End Time`)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Event) %>%
    mutate(bout = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Event, bout, start, end) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Event,
      values_from = c(start, end),
      names_glue = "{Event}_{.value}",
      values_fn = list(start = min, end = max)  # avoids duplicate warnings
    )

  # ✅ Ensure all expected columns exist
  required_cols <- c(
    "passive_start","passive_end",
    "social_start","social_end",
    "freeze_start","freeze_end"
  )
  
  for (col in required_cols) {
    if (!col %in% colnames(out)) {
      out[[col]] <- NA
    }
  }

  # ✅ Final ordering
  out %>%
    select(
      bout,
      passive_start, passive_end,
      social_start, social_end,
      freeze_start, freeze_end
    )
}
```

```{r}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Treat "", "NA" as NA
  x[x %in% c("", "NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))  # 🔴 force numeric
  
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl(":", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- sapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  })
  
  return(out)
}
summarize_behavior <- function(df) {
  
  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      social_start_s = time_to_sec(social_start),
      social_end_s   = time_to_sec(social_end),
      freeze_start_s = time_to_sec(freeze_start),
      freeze_end_s   = time_to_sec(freeze_end),
      
      social_dur = social_end_s - social_start_s,
      freeze_dur = if (all(is.na(freeze_start_s))) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        freeze_end_s - freeze_start_s
      }
    ) 
  
  # --- SOCIAL ---
  approach_social <- df2 %>%
    filter(approach_s %in% c("a", "b"))
  
  nonapproach_social <- df2 %>%
    filter(approach_s == "n")
  
  # --- FREEZE ---
  approach_freeze <- df2 %>%
    filter(approach_f %in% c("a", "b"))
  
  nonapproach_freeze <- df2 %>%
    filter(approach_f == "n")
  
  # --- TOTALS (NEW) ---
  social_all  <- df2 %>% filter(!is.na(social_dur))
  freeze_all  <- df2 %>% filter(!is.na(freeze_dur))
  
  data.frame(
    # --- APPROACH / NONAPPROACH SOCIAL ---
    approach_social_bouts = nrow(approach_social),
    approach_social_time  = sum(approach_social$social_dur, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    nonapproach_social_bouts = nrow(nonapproach_social),
    nonapproach_social_time  = sum(nonapproach_social$social_dur, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # --- APPROACH / NONAPPROACH FREEZE ---
    approach_freeze_bouts = nrow(approach_freeze),
    approach_freeze_time  = sum(approach_freeze$freeze_dur, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    nonapproach_freeze_bouts = nrow(nonapproach_freeze),
    nonapproach_freeze_time  = sum(nonapproach_freeze$freeze_dur, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # --- TOTALS (NEW) ---
    social_bouts = nrow(social_all),
    social_time  = sum(social_all$social_dur, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    freeze_bouts = nrow(freeze_all),
    freeze_time  = sum(freeze_all$freeze_dur, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{r}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Treat common bad patterns as NA
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  # Only accept valid mm:ss or mm:ss.xx
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    if (length(p) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

sec_to_mmss <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf("%02d:%05.2f", floor(x / 60), x %% 60)
  )
}

add_offset_simple <- function(df, offset_mmss) {
  
  offset_sec <- time_to_sec(offset_mmss)
  
  if (is.na(offset_sec)) {
    stop("Offset could not be parsed into seconds.")
  }
  
  time_cols <- c(
    "social_start", "social_end",
    "freeze_start", "freeze_end",
    "passive_start", "passive_end"
  )
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        any_of(time_cols),
        ~ {
          secs <- time_to_sec(.)
          sec_to_mmss(secs + offset_sec)
        }
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
plot_gantt_single_line <- function(df, title = NULL) {
  
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Convert MM:SS to seconds
  # -----------------------------
  time_to_sec <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
    
    out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
    valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl(":", x)
    
    parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
    
    out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
      if (length(p) < 2 || any(is.na(p))) return(NA_real_)
      as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
    }, numeric(1))
    
    out
  }
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Build plotting dataframe
  # -----------------------------
  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      social_start_sec  = time_to_sec(social_start),
      social_end_sec    = time_to_sec(social_end),
      freeze_start_sec  = time_to_sec(freeze_start),
      freeze_end_sec    = time_to_sec(freeze_end)
    ) %>%
    select(
      bout, approach_s, approach_f,
      social_start_sec, social_end_sec,
      freeze_start_sec, freeze_end_sec
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(bout, approach_s, approach_f),
      names_to = c("type", ".value"),
      names_pattern = "(social|freeze)_(start|end)_sec"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start) & !is.na(end)) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = case_when(
        type == "social" & approach_s %in% c("a", "b") ~ "Approach-Social",
        type == "social" & approach_s == "n"           ~ "Nonapproach-Social",
        type == "freeze" & approach_f %in% c("a", "b") ~ "Approach-Freeze",
        type == "freeze" & approach_f == "n"           ~ "Nonapproach-Freeze",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      start_min = start / 60,
      end_min   = end / 60
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Category)) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = factor(
        Category,
        levels = c(
          "Approach-Freeze",
          "Approach-Social",
          "Nonapproach-Freeze",
          "Nonapproach-Social"
        )
      ),
      y = as.numeric(Category)
    )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Plot
  # -----------------------------
  ggplot(plot_df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start_min,
        xmax = end_min,
        ymin = y - 0.45,
        ymax = y + 0.45,
        fill = Category
      ),
      color = NA
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      breaks = seq(0, ceiling(max(plot_df$end_min, na.rm = TRUE)), by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:4,
      labels = c(
        "Approach-Freeze",
        "Approach-Social",
        "Nonapproach-Freeze",
        "Nonapproach-Social"
      )
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Approach-Social"      = "#E69F00",
        "Nonapproach-Social"   = "#66CC00",
        "Approach-Freeze"      = "#0072B2",
        "Nonapproach-Freeze"   = "#999999"
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

# -----------------------------
# Merge nearby bouts (same as before)
# -----------------------------
merge_bouts <- function(df, gap = 1) {
  
  df %>%
    arrange(Video, Event, Start_time) %>%
    group_by(Video, Event) %>%
    mutate(
      gap_prev = Start_time - lag(`End Time`)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      new_group = ifelse(is.na(gap_prev) | gap_prev > gap, 1, 0),
      group_id = cumsum(new_group)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Video, Event, group_id) %>%
    summarise(
      Start_time = first(Start_time),
      `End Time` = last(`End Time`),
      Start_frame = first(Start_frame),
      End_frame = last(End_frame),
      Bout_time = `End Time` - Start_time,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Video, Event, Start_time)
}

bouts0416 <- merge_bouts(bouts0416, gap = 1)

# -----------------------------
# Convert to MM:SS.ss
# -----------------------------
convert_mmss2 <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%02d:%05.2f", floor(x / 60), x %% 60)
}

# -----------------------------
# Process each video
# -----------------------------
process_video <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  out <- df %>%
    filter(
      Video == video_name,
      Event %in% c("Exp_social", "Exp_withdraw", "Exp_freeze")
    ) %>%
    arrange(Start_time) %>%
    mutate(
      Event = recode(Event,
        Exp_social   = "social",
        Exp_withdraw = "withdraw",
        Exp_freeze   = "freeze"
      ),
      start = convert_mmss2(Start_time),
      end   = convert_mmss2(`End Time`)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Event) %>%
    mutate(bout = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Event, bout, start, end) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Event,
      values_from = c(start, end),
      names_glue = "{Event}_{.value}",
      values_fn = list(start = min, end = max)
    )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Ensure all columns exist
  # -----------------------------
  required_cols <- c(
    "social_start","social_end",
    "withdraw_start","withdraw_end",
    "freeze_start","freeze_end"
  )
  
  for (col in required_cols) {
    if (!col %in% colnames(out)) {
      out[[col]] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Final ordering
  # -----------------------------
  out %>%
    select(
      bout,
      social_start, social_end,
      withdraw_start, withdraw_end,
      freeze_start, freeze_end
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# Apply to each video
# -----------------------------
bouts_17_59_14 <- process_video(bouts0416, "0428_17_59_14")
```

```{r}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Treat common bad patterns as NA
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  # Only accept valid mm:ss or mm:ss.xx
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    if (length(p) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

add_offset_simple <- function(df, offset_mmss) {
  
  offset_sec <- time_to_sec(offset_mmss)
  
  if (is.na(offset_sec)) {
    stop("Offset could not be parsed into seconds.")
  }
  
  # ✅ UPDATED column list
  time_cols <- c(
    "social_start", "social_end",
    "freeze_start", "freeze_end",
    "withdraw_start", "withdraw_end"
  )
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        any_of(time_cols),
        ~ {
          secs <- time_to_sec(.)
          
          # Guard: if entire column is NA, keep NA
          if (all(is.na(secs))) return(rep(NA_character_, length(secs)))
          
          sec_to_mmss(secs + offset_sec)
        }
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
sec_to_mmss <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    paste0(round(x), "s")
  )
}

time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

make_summary_df <- function(df) {
  
  # -------------------------
  # Helper to expand rows
  # -------------------------
  expand_behavior <- function(data, approach_label, nonapproach_label) {
    
    data %>%
      filter(!is.na(start) & !is.na(end)) %>%
      mutate(
        behavior_list = case_when(
          flag == "a" ~ list(approach_label),
          flag == "n" ~ list(nonapproach_label),
          flag == "b" ~ list(c(approach_label, nonapproach_label)),
          TRUE ~ list(NA_character_)
        )
      ) %>%
      unnest(behavior_list) %>%
      rename(behavior = behavior_list)
  }
  
  
  # -------------------------
  # SOCIAL
  # -------------------------
  social_df <- if (all(c("social_start","social_end","approach_s") %in% names(df))) {
  df %>%
    transmute(
      start = time_to_sec(social_start),
      end   = time_to_sec(social_end),
      flag  = as.character(approach_s)
    ) %>%
    expand_behavior("approach_social", "nonapproach_social")
} else {
  tibble()
}
  
  
  # -------------------------
  # WITHDRAW
  # -------------------------
  withdraw_df <- if (all(c("withdraw_start","withdraw_end","approach_w") %in% names(df))) {
  df %>%
    transmute(
      start = time_to_sec(withdraw_start),
      end   = time_to_sec(withdraw_end),
      flag  = as.character(approach_w)
    ) %>%
    expand_behavior("approach_withdraw", "nonapproach_withdraw")
} else {
  tibble()
}
  
  # -------------------------
  # FREEZE
  # -------------------------
  freeze_df <- if (all(c("freeze_start","freeze_end","approach_f") %in% names(df))) {
  df %>%
    transmute(
      start = time_to_sec(freeze_start),
      end   = time_to_sec(freeze_end),
      flag  = as.character(approach_f)
    ) %>%
    expand_behavior("approach_freeze", "nonapproach_freeze")
} else {
  tibble()
}
  
  
  # -------------------------
  # Combine + short flag
  # -------------------------
 dfs <- list(social_df, withdraw_df)

if (exists("freeze_df") && nrow(freeze_df) > 0) {
  dfs <- append(dfs, list(freeze_df))
}

res <- bind_rows(dfs)

if (!"behavior" %in% names(res)) {
  return(tibble(
    start_time = numeric(),
    end_time = numeric(),
    behavior = character(),
    short_flag = numeric()
  ))
}

res %>%
  filter(!is.na(behavior)) %>%
  mutate(
    duration = end - start,
    short_flag = ifelse(duration <= 1, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(start) %>%
  select(start_time = start, end_time = end, behavior, short_flag)
}
```

```{r}
plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_df, tian_df) %>%
  mutate(
    source = factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris")),
    
    # Behavior type (for splitting plots)
    behavior_type = case_when(
      grepl("Social", category) ~ "Social",
      TRUE ~ "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    
    # Interaction type (for color consistency)
    interaction = case_when(
      grepl("^Approach", category) ~ "Approach",
      grepl("^Being Approached", category) ~ "Being Approached"
    )
  )
# Social colors

# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)

  "Approach" = "#1f77b4",
  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"

plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

```{r}
simba_adj <- sum_19_12_12 %>%
  rename(
    start = start_time,
    end   = end_time
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      behavior %in% c("approach_social") ~ "Approach->Social Interaction",
      
      behavior %in% c("approach_withdraw", "approach_freeze") ~ "Approach->Freeze/Withdraw",
      
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_freeze", "nonapproach_withdraw") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_social") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    source = "SimBA"
  )

tian_adj <- sum_tian19 %>%
  rename(
    behavior = Behavior,
    start = `Start (s)`,
    end   = `Stop (s)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      behavior == "E: E-I-social behavior" ~ "Approach->Social Interaction",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: E-I-freezing/no response") ~ "Approach->Freeze/Withdraw",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-avoidance", "E: I-E-freezing/no response", "I: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    source = "Human score with Boris"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), start != end)
plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_adj, tian_adj) %>%
  mutate(
    source = factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris")),
    
    # Behavior type (for splitting plots)
    behavior_type = case_when(
      grepl("Social", category) ~ "Social",
      TRUE ~ "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    
    # Interaction type (for color consistency)
    interaction = case_when(
      grepl("^Approach", category) ~ "Approach",
      grepl("^Being Approached", category) ~ "Being Approached"
    )
  )
# Social colors
social_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "green",
  "Being Approached" = "#FF10F0"
)

# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)
fw_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "#1f77b4",
  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"
)
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "19_12_12 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "19_12_12 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

social_counts <- plot_df %>%
  filter(behavior_type == "Social") %>%
  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(
  social_counts,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)

plot_social_combined
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# -----------------------------
# SimBA → 4 categories
# -----------------------------
simba_df <- sum_17_59_14 %>%
  filter(behavior %in% c(
    "approach_social",
    "nonapproach_social",
    "approach_freeze",
    "nonapproach_freeze",
    "approach_withdraw",
    "nonapproach_withdraw"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      behavior == "approach_social" ~ "A-S",
      behavior == "nonapproach_social" ~ "BA-S",
      behavior %in% c("approach_freeze", "approach_withdraw") ~ "A-W/F",
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_freeze", "nonapproach_withdraw") ~ "BA-W/F"
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(start = start_time, end = end_time, category)

# -----------------------------
# Tianhua → same 4 categories
# -----------------------------
tian_df <- sum_tian %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      Behavior %in% c("E: E-I-social behavior") ~ "A-S",
      Behavior %in% c("I: I-E-social behavior") ~ "BA-S",
      Behavior %in% c("E: E-I-freezing/no response") ~ "A-W/F",
      Behavior %in% c(
        "E: I-E-freezing/no response",
        "E: I-E-avoidance"
      ) ~ "BA-W/F"
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    start = `Start (s)`,
    end   = `Stop (s)`,
    category
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), start != end)

# -----------------------------
# Split by category
# -----------------------------
simba_split <- split(simba_df, simba_df$category)
tian_split  <- split(tian_df,  tian_df$category)

# -----------------------------
# Overlap functions (directional)
# -----------------------------
count_overlap_simba <- function(simba, tian, tol = 2) {
  if (nrow(simba) == 0 || nrow(tian) == 0) return(0)
  
  sum(sapply(simba$start, function(s) {
    any(abs(tian$start - s) <= tol)
  }))
}

count_overlap_tian <- function(simba, tian, tol = 2) {
  if (nrow(simba) == 0 || nrow(tian) == 0) return(0)
  
  sum(sapply(tian$start, function(t) {
    any(abs(simba$start - t) <= tol)
  }))
}

# -----------------------------
# Build comparison table
# -----------------------------
categories <- c("A-S", "BA-S", "A-W/F", "BA-W/F")

summary_table <- lapply(categories, function(cat) {
  
  simba_cat <- simba_split[[cat]]
  tian_cat  <- tian_split[[cat]]
  
  # Handle NULL safely
  if (is.null(simba_cat)) simba_cat <- data.frame(start = numeric(0))
  if (is.null(tian_cat))  tian_cat  <- data.frame(start = numeric(0))
  
  data.frame(
    Category = cat,
    SimBA_bouts = nrow(simba_cat),
    Tianhua_bouts = nrow(tian_cat),
    Overlap_SimBA = count_overlap_simba(simba_cat, tian_cat),
    Overlap_Tianhua = count_overlap_tian(simba_cat, tian_cat)
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# -----------------------------
# Optional: precision / recall
# -----------------------------
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  mutate(
    precision = ifelse(SimBA_bouts > 0,
                       Overlap_SimBA / SimBA_bouts, NA),
    recall = ifelse(Tianhua_bouts > 0,
                    Overlap_Tianhua / Tianhua_bouts, NA)
  )

# -----------------------------
# Final result
# -----------------------------
summary_table
```

```{r}
simba_df <- sum_19_12_12 %>%
  rename(
    start = start_time,
    end   = end_time
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      behavior %in% c("approach_social") ~ "Approach Social",
```

```{r}
make_AS_dataframe <- function(df) {
  
  # Convert all relevant times
  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      social_start_s = sec_to_mmss(time_to_sec(social_start)),
      social_end_s   = sec_to_mmss(time_to_sec(social_end)),
      
      withdraw_start_s = sec_to_mmss(time_to_sec(withdraw_start)),
      withdraw_end_s   = sec_to_mmss(time_to_sec(withdraw_end)),
      
      freeze_start_s = sec_to_mmss(time_to_sec(freeze_start)),
      freeze_end_s   = sec_to_mmss(time_to_sec(freeze_end))
    )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # A-S (approach social)
  # -----------------------------
  A_S <- bind_rows(
    df2 %>%
      filter(approach_s %in% c("a", "b")) %>%
      transmute(start = social_start_s, end = social_end_s),
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # BA-S (nonapproach social)
  # -----------------------------
  BA_S <- bind_rows(
    df2 %>%
      filter(approach_s %in% c("n", "b")) %>%
      transmute(start = social_start_s, end = social_end_s)
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # A-W/F (approach withdraw + freeze)
  # -----------------------------
  A_WF <- bind_rows(
    df2 %>%
      filter(approach_w %in% c("a", "b")) %>%
      transmute(start = withdraw_start_s, end = withdraw_end_s),
    
    df2 %>%
      filter(approach_f %in% c("a", "b")) %>%
      transmute(start = freeze_start_s, end = freeze_end_s)
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # BA-W/F (nonapproach withdraw + freeze)
  # -----------------------------
  BA_WF <- bind_rows(
    df2 %>%
      filter(approach_w %in% c("n", "b")) %>%
      transmute(start = withdraw_start_s, end = withdraw_end_s),
    
    df2 %>%
      filter(approach_f %in% c("n", "b")) %>%
      transmute(start = freeze_start_s, end = freeze_end_s)
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Clean + label
  # -----------------------------
  clean_cat <- function(d, name) {
    d %>%
      filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end)) %>%
      arrange(start) %>%
      mutate(cat = name)
  }
  
  out <- bind_rows(
    clean_cat(A_S,  "A-S"),
    clean_cat(BA_S, "BA-S"),
    clean_cat(A_WF, "A-W/F"),
    clean_cat(BA_WF,"BA-W/F")
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Final wide format
  # -----------------------------
  out %>%
    group_by(cat) %>%
    mutate(bout = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = cat,
      values_from = c(start, end),
      names_glue = "{cat}_{.value}",
      values_fn = list(start = min, end = max)
    ) %>%
    arrange(bout)
}
AS_17_59_14 <- make_AS_dataframe(lab_17_59_14)
AS_19_12_12 <- make_AS_dataframe(lab_19_12_12)

reorder_AS_cols <- function(df) {
  
  desired_order <- c(
    "A-S_start", "A-S_end",
    "BA-S_start", "BA-S_end",
    "A-W/F_start", "A-W/F_end",
    "BA-W/F_start", "BA-W/F_end"
  )
  
  # Keep only existing columns (safe if some categories missing)
  existing <- desired_order[desired_order %in% names(df)]
  
  df %>%
    select(bout, all_of(existing))
}
AS_17_59_14 <- reorder_AS_cols(AS_17_59_14)
AS_19_12_12 <- reorder_AS_cols(AS_19_12_12)
```

```{r}
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

)

  fw_colors
)

social_counts <- plot_df %>%
  filter(behavior_type == "Social") %>%
  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), start != end)
plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_adj, tian_adj) %>%
  mutate(
    source = factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris")),
    
    # Behavior type (for splitting plots)
    behavior_type = case_when(
      grepl("Social", category) ~ "Social",
      TRUE ~ "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    
    # Interaction type (for color consistency)
    interaction = case_when(
      grepl("^Approach", category) ~ "Approach",
      grepl("^Being Approached", category) ~ "Being Approached"
    )
  )
# Social colors
social_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "green",
  "Being Approached" = "#FF10F0"
)

# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)
fw_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "#1f77b4",
  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"
)
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "18_55_10 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "18_55_10 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

# -----------------------------
# Count table function
# -----------------------------
social_counts <- plot_df %>%
  filter(behavior_type == "Social") %>%
  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(
  social_counts,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)

plot_social_combined <- plot_social / table_grob_social +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))  # plot bigger than table

plot_social_combined
```

```{r}
  "Approach" = "green",
  "Being Approached" = "#FF10F0"
)

# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)
fw_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "#1f77b4",
  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"
)
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "18_37_02 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "18_37_02 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

# -----------------------------
# Count table function
# -----------------------------
social_counts <- plot_df %>%
  filter(behavior_type == "Social") %>%
  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(
  social_counts,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)

plot_social_combined <- plot_social / table_grob_social +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))  # plot bigger than table

plot_social_combined

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_freeze", "nonapproach_withdraw") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_social") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    source = "SimBA"

  ) %>%

    category = case_when(
      behavior == "E: E-I-social behavior" ~ "Approach->Social Interaction",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: E-I-freezing/no response") ~ "Approach->Freeze/Withdraw",

    ),

plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

sec_to_sec_label <- function(x) {
  paste0(round(x, 2))
}

# -----------------------------
# Main processing for ONE video
# -----------------------------
process_one_video <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  # Safe getter: returns NA vector if column missing
  get_col <- function(data, col) {
    if (col %in% names(data)) data[[col]] else rep(NA, nrow(data))
  }
  
  long_df <- bind_rows(
    
    # --- SOCIAL ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_s") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Social"
    ),
    
    # --- WITHDRAW ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_w") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    
    # --- FREEZE ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_f") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    )
    
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics (unchanged)
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
    approach_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach"),
    approach_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    approach_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    approach_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    ba_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    ba_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    short_bouts = sum(long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  tibble(
    Video = video_name,
    
    `Approach bouts` = summary$approach_bouts,
    `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
    `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
    `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
    
    `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
    `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
    
    `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
    `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
    
    `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
    `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
    
    `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
    `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time),
    
    `<=1 seconds` = summary$short_bouts
  )
}
```

```{r}
process_reclassified <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  get_col <- function(data, col) {
    if (col %in% names(data)) data[[col]] else rep(NA, nrow(data))
  }
  
  long_df <- bind_rows(
    
    # --- SOCIAL ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_end")),
      interaction = case_when(
        get_col(df, "approach_s") == "a" ~ "Approach",
        get_col(df, "approach_s") == "n" ~ "Being Approached",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      type = "Social"
    ),
    
    # --- WITHDRAW ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_end")),
      interaction = case_when(
        get_col(df, "approach_w") == "a" ~ "Approach",
        get_col(df, "approach_w") == "n" ~ "Being Approached",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      type = "Withdraw"
    ),
    
    # --- FREEZE ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_end")),
      interaction = case_when(
        get_col(df, "approach_f") == "a" ~ "Approach",
        get_col(df, "approach_f") == "n" ~ "Being Approached",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      type = "Freeze"
    )
    
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start, !is.na(interaction)) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # 🔥 RECLASSIFICATION
  # -----------------------------
  long_df <- long_df %>%
    mutate(
      new_type = case_when(
        
        # ≤1s social OR withdraw → Withdraw bucket
        duration <= 1 & type %in% c("Social", "Withdraw") ~ "Withdraw_short",
        
        # >1s social → Social
        duration > 1 & type == "Social" ~ "Social_long",
        
        # >1s withdraw → Freeze
        duration > 1 & type == "Withdraw" ~ "Freeze",
        
        # Freeze stays Freeze
        type == "Freeze" ~ "Freeze",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Summaries
  # -----------------------------
  sum_fun <- function(cond) {
    list(
      bouts = sum(cond, na.rm = TRUE),
      time  = sum(long_df$duration[cond], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
  
  # Approach
  A_withdraw <- sum_fun(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$new_type == "Withdraw_short")
  A_social   <- sum_fun(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$new_type == "Social_long")
  A_freeze   <- sum_fun(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$new_type == "Freeze")
  
  # Being Approached
  BA_withdraw <- sum_fun(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$new_type == "Withdraw_short")
  BA_social   <- sum_fun(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$new_type == "Social_long")
  BA_freeze   <- sum_fun(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$new_type == "Freeze")
  
  tibble(
    Video = video_name,
    
    # Approach
    `Approach-Withdraw(<=1s)` = A_withdraw$bouts,
    `Withdraw-time`           = sec_to_sec_label(A_withdraw$time),
    
    `Approach-Social(>1s)` = A_social$bouts,
    `Social-time`          = sec_to_sec_label(A_social$time),
    
    `Approach-Freeze` = A_freeze$bouts,
    `Freeze-time`     = sec_to_sec_label(A_freeze$time),
    
    # Being Approached
    `BA-Withdraw(<=1s)` = BA_withdraw$bouts,
    `BA-Withdraw-time`  = sec_to_sec_label(BA_withdraw$time),
    
    `BA-Social(>1s)` = BA_social$bouts,
    `BA-Social-time` = sec_to_sec_label(BA_social$time),
    
    `BA-Freeze` = BA_freeze$bouts,
    `BA-Freeze-time` = sec_to_sec_label(BA_freeze$time)
  )
}
reclass_summary <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(video_list), function(name) {
    process_reclassified(video_list[[name]], name)
  })
)

write.xlsx(
  list(
    "Original Summary" = final_summary,
    "Reclassified Summary" = reclass_summary
  ),
  file = "Sum_0430.xlsx"
)
```

```{r}
process_one_video_boris <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  long_df <- df %>%
    rename(
      behavior = Behavior,
      start = `Start (s)`,
      end   = `Stop (s)`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    
    mutate(
      duration = end - start
    )
    
    mutate(
      interaction = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: E-I-freezing/no response"
        ) ~ "Approach",
        
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: I-E-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/no response"
        ) ~ "Being Approached",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      type = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-social behavior"
        ) ~ "Social",
        
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-freezing/no response",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/no response"
        ) ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    
    filter(!is.na(interaction), !is.na(type))
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics (IDENTICAL structure)
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
    
    approach_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach"),
    approach_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    approach_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    approach_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    ba_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    ba_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    short_bouts = sum(long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Output (IDENTICAL columns)
  # -----------------------------
  tibble(
    Video = video_name,
    
    `Approach bouts` = summary$approach_bouts,
    `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
    `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
    `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
    
    `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
    `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
    
    `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
    `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
    
    `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
    `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
    
    `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
    `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time),
    
    `<=1 seconds` = summary$short_bouts
  )
}
```

```{r}
counts_bouts <- sapply(video_features, function(df) {

  dist <- df$Mean_Euclidean_distance_Midcenter_1_Midcenter_2_15
  move <- df$Mean_All_bp_movements_Experiment_mean_2

  dist[is.na(dist)] <- Inf
  move[is.na(move)] <- 999

  # 1. define close state
  close <- dist <= 150

  # 2. detect transition: was far (>150) then becomes close (<=150)
  entry <- c(FALSE, close[-1] & !close[-length(close)])

  entry_idx <- which(entry)

  # 3. build event windows (next 300 frames)
  window <- rep(FALSE, length(df[[1]]))

  for (i in entry_idx) {
    end <- min(i + 300, length(window))
    window[i:end] <- TRUE
  }

  # 4. condition: low movement AND within event window
  cond <- window &
          move < 0.3 & close

  cond[is.na(cond)] <- FALSE

  # 5. run-length encode to get bouts
  r <- rle(cond)
  sum(r$values & r$lengths >= 10)
})

  keep <- !is.na(df$Mean_Euclidean_distance_Midcenter_1_Midcenter_2_15) &
          df$Mean_Euclidean_distance_Midcenter_1_Midcenter_2_15 < 100
  mean(df$Mean_All_bp_movements_Experiment_mean_2[keep], na.rm = TRUE)
})
```

```{r}
group_1 <- c(
  "0428_17_59_14.csv",
  "0428_18_17_10.csv",
  "0428_18_37_02.csv",
  "0428_18_55_10.csv",
  "0428_20_48_07.csv",
  "0428_21_05_10.csv",
  "0513_20_30_41.csv",
  "0513_18_11_53.csv",
  "0513_18_55_52.csv",
  "0513_20_16_35.csv",
  "0513_18_41_12.csv",
  "0513_18_26_40.csv"
)

group_0 <- c(
  "0428_19_12_12.csv",
  "0428_19_34_39.csv",
  "0428_20_04_14.csv",
  "0428_20_23_51.csv",
  "0428_21_19_29.csv",
  "0428_21_33_38.csv",
  "0513_19_10_43.csv",
  "0513_20_58_32.csv",
  "0513_19_24_45.csv",
  "0513_19_38_40.csv",
  "0513_19_52_19.csv",
  "0513_20_44_36.csv"
)

# -----------------------------
# Process all files
# -----------------------------
files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

for (file in files) {
  
  filename <- basename(file)
  
  # Determine condition
  condition_value <- case_when(
    filename %in% group_1 ~ 1L,
    filename %in% group_0 ~ 0L,
    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  )
  
  # Read file
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Add column
  df <- df %>% mutate(condition = condition_value)
  
  # Overwrite file (or change path if you want new copies)
  write_csv(df, file)
}
```

```{r}
# Base folder
base_folder <- "~/Desktop/Project_0404/Project_0404/project_folder/csv"

# Folders to process
folders <- c("features_extracted", "targets_inserted")

for (subfolder in folders) {
  
  folder_path <- file.path(base_folder, subfolder)
  
  csv_files <- list.files(
    folder_path,
    pattern = "\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  for (file in csv_files) {
    
    df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    if ("condition" %in% names(df)) {
      
      df <- df %>%
        select(-condition)
      
      write_csv(df, file)
      
      message("Removed condition column from: ",
              basename(file),
              " (", subfolder, ")")
      
    } else {
      
      message("No condition column found in: ",
              basename(file),
              " (", subfolder, ")")
    }
  }
}

message("Finished processing all files.")
```

```{r}
      xmax = end/60,
      ymin = as.numeric(source)-0.35,
      ymax = as.numeric(source)+0.35,
      fill = category
    ),
    alpha = 0.9,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:2,
    labels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"),
    limits = c(0.5,2.5)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Time (minutes)",
    limits = c(1.5,12),
    breaks = seq(2,12,1),
    expand = c(0,0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = approach_colors, na.translate = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "18_17_10 Approach Behaviors",
    fill = "Behavior"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold"),
    aspect.ratio = 0.15,
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
process_one_video_boris <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  long_df <- df %>%
    rename(
      behavior = Behavior,
      start = `Start (s)`,
      end   = `Stop (s)`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    
    mutate(
      duration = end - start
    )
    
    mutate(
      interaction = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: E-I-freezing/no response"
        ) ~ "Approach",
        
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: I-E-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/no response"
        ) ~ "Being Approached",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      type = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-social behavior"
        ) ~ "Social",
        
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-freezing/no response",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/no response"
        ) ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    
    filter(!is.na(interaction), !is.na(type))
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics (IDENTICAL structure)
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
    approach_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach"),
    approach_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    approach_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    approach_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    ba_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    ba_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    short_bouts = sum(long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Output (IDENTICAL columns)
  # -----------------------------
  tibble(
    Video = video_name,
    
    `Approach bouts` = summary$approach_bouts,
    `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
    `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
    `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
    
    `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
    `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
    
    `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
    `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
    
    `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
    `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
    
    `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
    `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time),
    
    `<=1 seconds` = summary$short_bouts
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)

      ")"

  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)
```

```{r}
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_social") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",

    ),
    source = "SimBA"

    behavior = Behavior,
    start = `Start (s)`,
    end   = `Stop (s)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      behavior == "E: E-I-social behavior" ~ "Approach->Social Interaction",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: E-I-freezing/no response") ~ "Approach->Freeze/Withdraw",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-avoidance", "E: I-E-freezing/no response", "I: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",

plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)
fw_colors <- c(
```

```{r}
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "19_10_43 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "19_10_43 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

  {
    df <- .

      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",

      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(

)
```
